variants.note: Tự kiểm tra: điền giới từ vào chỗ trống.

variants.definition: for
variants.example: Regional integration pacts serve as an indispensable catalyst for shared prosperity.
variants.note: Tự kiểm tra: điền giới từ vào chỗ trống.

variants.definition: for
variants.example: Major soccer triumphs act as a magnificent catalyst for nationwide solidarity.
variants.note: Tự kiểm tra: điền giới từ vào chỗ trống.

cards.definition: khoanh riêng và bảo vệ ngân sách chi thiết yếu
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: khoanh riêng và bảo vệ ngân sách chi thiết yếu
variants.example: The council should ring-fence essential spending on clean water before allocating money to prestige projects.
variants.originalDefinition: bảo đảm ngân sách cho các khoản chi thiết yếu
variants.originalExample: Public institutions can ring-fence essential spending when reform is backed by clear incentives, credible monitoring and sustained investment.

cards.originalDefinition: bảo đảm ngân sách cho các khoản chi thiết yếu

cards.definition: tăng cường giám sát thu chi ngân sách nhà nước
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: tăng cường giám sát thu chi ngân sách nhà nước
variants.example: One practical way for public institutions to strengthen fiscal oversight is to pair targeted funding with transparent implementation and regular evaluation.

cards.definition: kiểm toán mua sắm công
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: kiểm toán mua sắm công
variants.example: Inspectors audit public procurement by comparing tender documents, contract prices and the goods that were actually delivered.
variants.originalDefinition: kiểm toán hoạt động mua sắm công
variants.originalExample: Unless public institutions audit public procurement, short-term gains are unlikely to translate into durable improvements in institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.originalDefinition: kiểm toán hoạt động mua sắm công

cards.definition: phân quyền cung cấp dịch vụ cho địa phương
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: phân quyền cung cấp dịch vụ cho địa phương
variants.example: A government may decentralise service delivery so that local offices can respond more quickly to residents' needs.
variants.originalDefinition: phân cấp việc cung cấp dịch vụ công
variants.originalExample: Well-designed policy can decentralise service delivery without imposing unnecessary administrative burdens or shifting hidden costs onto vulnerable groups.

cards.originalDefinition: phân cấp việc cung cấp dịch vụ công

cards.definition: đơn giản hóa thủ tục hành chính
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: đơn giản hóa thủ tục hành chính
variants.example: Allowing applicants to submit one verified set of documents would simplify administrative procedures without removing essential checks.
variants.originalDefinition: đơn giản hóa thủ tục hành chính
variants.originalExample: By choosing to simplify administrative procedures, public institutions can strengthen institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money while limiting the risk of unintended consequences.

cards.originalDefinition: đơn giản hóa thủ tục hành chính

cards.definition: kiềm chế lãng phí hành chính
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: kiềm chế lãng phí hành chính
variants.example: The case for intervention is strongest where public institutions can curb bureaucratic waste and demonstrate measurable gains in institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.definition: công khai lợi ích riêng ảnh hưởng tính khách quan
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: công khai lợi ích riêng ảnh hưởng tính khách quan
variants.example: Authors should disclose conflicts of interest so that readers can assess whether financial ties might influence their conclusions.
variants.originalDefinition: công khai xung đột lợi ích
variants.originalExample: Effective reform requires public institutions to disclose conflicts of interest, rather than relying on symbolic measures that leave structural constraints untouched.

cards.originalDefinition: công khai xung đột lợi ích

cards.definition: cải thiện tính minh bạch ngân sách
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: cải thiện tính minh bạch ngân sách
variants.example: A credible long-term strategy should improve budget transparency while preserving fairness, accountability and institutional capacity.

cards.definition: hướng hỗ trợ xã hội tới đúng nhóm cần giúp
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: hướng hỗ trợ xã hội tới đúng nhóm cần giúp
variants.example: To target social transfers effectively, officials must use eligibility criteria that do not exclude families whose income fluctuates.
variants.originalDefinition: nhắm đúng đối tượng cho các khoản chuyển giao xã hội
variants.originalExample: Evidence from well-governed systems suggests that it is possible to target social transfers without sacrificing broader objectives related to institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.originalDefinition: nhắm đúng đối tượng cho các khoản chuyển giao xã hội

cards.definition: khắc phục kẽ hở quy định
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: khắc phục kẽ hở quy định
variants.example: Lawmakers should close regulatory loopholes that allow companies to advertise mandatory fees as optional extras.
variants.originalDefinition: khép các kẽ hở pháp lý
variants.originalExample: Rather than treating the issue in isolation, public institutions should close regulatory loopholes as part of a coherent strategy for improving institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.originalDefinition: khép các kẽ hở pháp lý

cards.definition: phối hợp hành động giữa các cơ quan
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: phối hợp hành động giữa các cơ quan
variants.example: Where resources are limited, the priority should be to coordinate interagency action in ways that deliver the greatest long-term benefit for institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.definition: hiện đại hóa dịch vụ công
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: hiện đại hóa dịch vụ công
variants.example: The most durable reforms are those that modernise public services while also addressing the incentives that produced the original problem.

cards.definition: đánh giá các kết quả của chính sách
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: đánh giá các kết quả của chính sách
variants.example: To evaluate policy outcomes, researchers should compare actual changes in household incomes with the objectives announced at the outset.
variants.originalDefinition: đánh giá kết quả chính sách
variants.originalExample: For public institutions, the challenge is not merely to spend more, but to evaluate policy outcomes with sufficient precision to improve institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.originalDefinition: đánh giá kết quả chính sách

cards.definition: hỏi ý kiến các cộng đồng chịu ảnh hưởng
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: hỏi ý kiến các cộng đồng chịu ảnh hưởng
variants.example: Planners should consult affected communities before deciding which homes must be relocated for a new railway.
variants.originalDefinition: tham vấn các cộng đồng chịu tác động
variants.originalExample: A narrow intervention may fail unless policymakers also consult affected communities and remove the institutional bottlenecks that undermine institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money.

cards.originalDefinition: tham vấn các cộng đồng chịu tác động

cards.definition: bảo vệ tính độc lập của cơ quan, tổ chức
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: bảo vệ tính độc lập của cơ quan, tổ chức
variants.example: Transparent appointment rules can uphold institutional independence by reducing the scope for political pressure on regulators.
variants.originalDefinition: duy trì tính độc lập của thể chế
variants.originalExample: Over the medium term, efforts to uphold institutional independence are likely to be more effective when outcomes are measured openly and adjusted in response to evidence.

cards.originalDefinition: duy trì tính độc lập của thể chế

cards.definition: bảo vệ người tố giác sai phạm
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: bảo vệ người tố giác sai phạm
variants.example: Public support is easier to sustain when public institutions protect whistle-blowers through transparent rules rather than ad hoc or politically selective measures.

cards.definition: đánh giá hiệu suất dịch vụ so với chuẩn tham chiếu
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: đánh giá hiệu suất dịch vụ so với chuẩn tham chiếu
variants.example: Councils benchmark service performance against comparable authorities rather than relying solely on their own previous results.
variants.originalDefinition: đối chuẩn hiệu suất dịch vụ
variants.originalExample: Even modest investment can have an outsized effect if it is used to benchmark service performance at the point where constraints on institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money are greatest.

cards.originalDefinition: đối chuẩn hiệu suất dịch vụ

cards.definition: cải cách quản lý thuế
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: cải cách quản lý thuế
variants.example: The government could reform tax administration by simplifying registration and making the appeals process easier to navigate.
variants.originalDefinition: cải cách quản lý thuế
variants.originalExample: The policy becomes defensible when it can reform tax administration without generating new inequalities or weakening institutional trust.

cards.originalDefinition: cải cách quản lý thuế

cards.definition: giảm khoảng cách giữa chính sách và thực thi
cards.label: Verb collocations

variants.definition: giảm khoảng cách giữa chính sách và thực thi
variants.example: In practice, public institutions need to reduce implementation gaps consistently enough for improvements in institutional legitimacy and efficient use of public money to survive beyond a single policy cycle.

cards.definition: trách nhiệm giải trình thu chi, quản lý ngân sách
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: trách nhiệm giải trình thu chi, quản lý ngân sách
variants.example: Fiscal accountability requires public bodies to explain how money is spent and accept scrutiny when promised services fail to materialise.

originalRelations.synonyms: answerability · institutional responsibility · public scrutiny · oversight · responsible governance
originalRelations.antonyms: impunity · lack of oversight · unaccountability · opaque decision-making · institutional negligence

variants.originalExample: Fiscal accountability deserves serious attention because it can strengthen institutional legitimacy and efficient public services while reducing exposure to waste, distrust and weak implementation.

cards.definition: chất lượng dịch vụ công
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: chất lượng dịch vụ công
variants.example: Public service quality should be measured through reliable delivery and fair treatment of users, not merely the number of forms processed.

originalRelations.synonyms: high standards · calibre · excellence · service standard · overall effectiveness
originalRelations.antonyms: poor standards · deterioration · inferior quality · underperformance · substandard provision

variants.originalExample: Improving public service quality can be a high-leverage intervention when it addresses structural constraints rather than treating only visible symptoms.

cards.definition: hiệu quả sử dụng ngân sách
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: hiệu quả sử dụng ngân sách
variants.example: Transparent procurement can improve budget efficiency by reducing avoidable expenditure without compromising the quality of essential public services.

originalRelations.synonyms: cost-effectiveness · resource efficiency · productive use · operational efficiency · value for resources
originalRelations.antonyms: waste · inefficiency · poor allocation · resource leakage · low productivity

variants.originalDefinition: hiệu quả ngân sách
variants.originalExample: A well-designed policy can strengthen budget efficiency, but its success ultimately depends on whether the gains persist once temporary funding or political attention fades.

cards.originalDefinition: hiệu quả ngân sách

cards.definition: hiệu quả đạt được so với chi phí bỏ ra
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: hiệu quả đạt được so với chi phí bỏ ra
variants.example: Debate about cost-effectiveness is often oversimplified; the more useful question is which institutional conditions allow it to improve institutional legitimacy and efficient public services in practice.

variants.definition: hiệu quả đạt được so với chi phí bỏ ra
variants.example: The cost-effectiveness of an intervention depends on the benefits it produces relative to its full costs, not simply on whether its initial price is low.

cards.definition: hiệu quả dùng nguồn lực, hạn chế lãng phí
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: hiệu quả dùng nguồn lực, hạn chế lãng phí
variants.example: Repairing durable products can improve resource efficiency by extending their useful lives and reducing the demand for newly extracted materials.
variants.originalDefinition: hiệu quả sử dụng nguồn lực
variants.originalExample: Investment in resource efficiency is difficult to justify if it produces impressive headline figures while leaving waste, distrust and weak implementation largely untouched.

variants.definition: hiệu quả dùng nguồn lực, hạn chế lãng phí
variants.example: Repairing durable products can improve resource efficiency by extending their useful lives and reducing the demand for newly extracted materials.

originalRelations.synonyms: cost-effectiveness · efficient resource use · resource productivity · input efficiency · lean resource use
originalRelations.antonyms: resource waste · inefficient consumption · overuse of resources · low resource productivity · wasteful production

variants.originalDefinition: hiệu quả sử dụng tài nguyên
variants.originalExample: One reason resource efficiency matters is that it shapes not only average outcomes but also how opportunities and risks are distributed across social groups.

cards.originalDefinition: hiệu quả sử dụng nguồn lực

cards.definition: sử dụng tạo kết quả hữu ích
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: sử dụng tạo kết quả hữu ích
variants.example: Publishing clear spending data helps citizens judge whether public funds have been put to productive use.
variants.originalDefinition: việc sử dụng hiệu quả
variants.originalExample: Productive use should therefore be assessed through longitudinal evidence, particularly where benefits and costs emerge at different points in time.

cards.originalDefinition: việc sử dụng hiệu quả

cards.definition: hiệu quả hoạt động với ít lãng phí nguồn lực
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: hiệu quả hoạt động với ít lãng phí nguồn lực
variants.example: Reducing duplicate administrative steps can improve operational efficiency, provided that the removed checks are genuinely redundant rather than necessary safeguards.
variants.originalDefinition: hiệu quả vận hành
variants.originalExample: When authorities neglect operational efficiency, apparently minor weaknesses can accumulate until they begin to undermine institutional legitimacy and efficient public services.

cards.originalDefinition: hiệu quả vận hành

cards.definition: giá trị, lợi ích từ nguồn lực đã dùng
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: giá trị, lợi ích từ nguồn lực đã dùng
variants.example: The programme offers value for resources when a modest investment in staff training leads to lasting improvements in service quality.
variants.originalDefinition: giá trị thu được từ nguồn lực sử dụng
variants.originalExample: Strengthening value for resources may involve upfront costs, yet those costs can be outweighed by the long-term damage associated with waste, distrust and weak implementation.

cards.originalDefinition: giá trị thu được từ nguồn lực sử dụng

cards.definition: minh bạch hoạt động, quyết định của tổ chức
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: minh bạch hoạt động, quyết định của tổ chức
variants.example: Institutional transparency improves when the public can inspect the reasons for a decision rather than merely receive its outcome.

originalRelations.synonyms: openness · public disclosure · institutional visibility · clear reporting · open governance
originalRelations.antonyms: opacity · secrecy · concealment · closed decision-making · information asymmetry

variants.originalDefinition: minh bạch thể chế
variants.originalExample: An exclusive focus on efficiency can weaken institutional transparency, which in turn may reduce public confidence even when aggregate performance improves.

cards.originalDefinition: minh bạch thể chế

cards.definition: tính cởi mở
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: tính cởi mở
variants.example: Openness about an unsuccessful trial can help other researchers avoid repeating the same mistake, provided that its methods and limitations are explained clearly.

cards.definition: công khai thông tin
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: công khai thông tin
variants.example: Public disclosure of campaign donations allows voters to examine potential conflicts of interest before an election.
variants.originalDefinition: sự công khai thông tin
variants.originalExample: Public disclosure should not be treated as an abstract ideal; it has concrete implications for institutional legitimacy and efficient public services and for the likelihood of waste, distrust and weak implementation.

cards.originalDefinition: sự công khai thông tin

cards.definition: mức độ tổ chức được công chúng biết đến, chú ý
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: mức độ tổ chức được công chúng biết đến, chú ý
variants.example: Publishing research summaries can increase institutional visibility, but visibility alone does not prove transparency.
variants.originalDefinition: mức độ minh bạch của thể chế
variants.originalExample: Improving institutional visibility requires more than additional funding: it also depends on enforcement, administrative competence and credible accountability.

cards.originalDefinition: mức độ minh bạch của thể chế

cards.definition: báo cáo rõ ràng, dễ hiểu
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: báo cáo rõ ràng, dễ hiểu
variants.example: Clear reporting separates confirmed findings from estimates so that readers can judge how much confidence to place in a conclusion.
variants.originalDefinition: báo cáo minh bạch, rõ ràng
variants.originalExample: If reform strengthens clear reporting only for already advantaged groups, it may widen rather than narrow the underlying problem.

cards.originalDefinition: báo cáo minh bạch, rõ ràng

cards.definition: quản trị minh bạch, cho phép công chúng tham gia
cards.label: Writing Task 2

variants.definition: quản trị minh bạch, cho phép công chúng tham gia
variants.example: Open governance allows residents to inspect spending records and understand how their views influence local decisions.
variants.originalDefinition: quản trị cởi mở, minh bạch
variants.originalExample: A balanced approach to open governance should recognise legitimate trade-offs while still protecting the institutional foundations of institutional legitimacy and efficient public services.

cards.originalDefinition: quản trị cởi mở, minh bạch

cards.term: a long-running source of public frustration

variants.sourceTitle: Hanoi wants $95,000 income and a spot among world's happiest capitals by 2065

cards.definition: tình trạng kinh tế - xã hội bấp bênh

variants.usagePattern: cụm danh từ (Noun phrase); face / navigate / be trapped in + precarious socio-economic situations
variants.synonyms: fragile economic circumstances · unstable livelihoods

variants.sourceTitle: Vietnamese people want to migrate to HCMC, Hanoi the most

cards.definition: siết chặt quy trình vận hành hồ chứa

variants.usagePattern: cụm từ cố định (Collocation); S + tighten reservoir operation protocols
variants.synonyms: enforce stricter dam management rules · toughen water-release standards
variants.note: Nguồn: South-central Vietnam reels from worst flooding in half a century (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/environment/south-central-vietnam-reels-from-worst-flooding-in-half-a-century-4985488.html)
variants.sourceTitle: South-central Vietnam reels from worst flooding in half a century

cards.definition: chịu mức phạt tiền
cards.label: Topic collocations
cards.usagePattern: cụm từ cố định (Collocation); offense + carry a fine + of N

variants.definition: chịu mức phạt tiền
variants.example: Under revised environmental legislation, illegally dumping industrial solvents now carries a fine substantial enough to deter even highly profitable conglomerates.
variants.usagePattern: cụm từ cố định (Collocation); offense + carry a fine + of N
variants.synonyms: incur a monetary penalty · entail a financial sanction
variants.note: Nguồn: Man jailed for using twin brother's passport to slip past Singapore border checks (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/crime/man-jailed-for-using-twin-brother-s-passport-to-slip-past-singapore-border-checks-5146027.html)
variants.sourceTitle: Man jailed for using twin brother's passport to slip past Singapore border checks

cards.definition: số người thiệt mạng

variants.definition: số người thiệt mạng
variants.example: Early warning sirens and rapid coastal evacuations significantly reduced the potential death toll when the category-four cyclone struck the southern peninsula.
variants.usagePattern: cụm danh từ (Noun phrase); the + death toll + from N + rise to / exceed [number]
variants.synonyms: fatality count · number of casualties

variants.sourceTitle: At least 30 people killed in Spain when two high-speed trains collide

cards.definition: bù đắp cho, làm bù cho
cards.label: Phrasal verbs
cards.usagePattern: cụm động từ (Phrasal verb); S + compensate for + N/V-ing

variants.definition: bù đắp cho, làm bù cho
variants.example: While automation can compensate for shrinking working-age populations in advanced economies, it cannot entirely replace human judgment in complex social services.
variants.usagePattern: cụm động từ (Phrasal verb); S + compensate for + N/V-ing
variants.synonyms: offset · make up for
variants.note: Nguồn: Vietnamese to have 5-day break for National Day (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnamese-to-have-5-day-break-for-national-day-5085518.html)
variants.sourceTitle: Vietnamese to have 5-day break for National Day

cards.definition: bị bao phủ trong lớp khói mù

variants.definition: bị bao phủ trong lớp khói mù

variants.usagePattern: collocation; S + be shrouded in haze
variants.synonyms: enveloped in smog · blanketed in thick smoke
variants.note: Nguồn: Indonesia apologizes to Malaysia, Singapore as wildfire haze sickens hundreds of thousands (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/environment/indonesia-apologizes-to-malaysia-singapore-as-wildfire-haze-sickens-hundreds-of-thousands-5145183.html)
variants.sourceTitle: Indonesia apologizes to Malaysia, Singapore as wildfire haze sickens hundreds of thousands

cards.definition: thu hồi quyền sử dụng đất (được cấp phép)
cards.label: Topic collocations
cards.usagePattern: collocation; S + revoke land concessions + from N

variants.definition: thu hồi quyền sử dụng đất (được cấp phép)
variants.example: To deter illegal deforestation, environmental ministries must swiftly revoke land concessions from agribusiness conglomerates caught violating zero-burning regulations.
variants.usagePattern: collocation; S + revoke land concessions + from N
variants.synonyms: cancel land-use permits · rescind logging licenses
variants.note: Nguồn: Indonesia apologizes to Malaysia, Singapore as wildfire haze sickens hundreds of thousands (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/environment/indonesia-apologizes-to-malaysia-singapore-as-wildfire-haze-sickens-hundreds-of-thousands-5145183.html)
variants.sourceTitle: Indonesia apologizes to Malaysia, Singapore as wildfire haze sickens hundreds of thousands
